name: 药理学与靶点开发预设
description: 专注于药物分子、成药靶点、药理作用机制(MoA)与临床适应症评估的分类体系。

Druggable_Target.label: 成药靶点蛋白 / 受体
Druggable_Target.description: 激酶、GPCR、核受体、离子通道等具备调控潜力的生物靶标
Druggable_Target.en_description: Kinases, GPCRs, nuclear receptors, ion channels, or disease-modifying biological targets.

Small_Molecule_Drug.label: 小分子化学药物 / 先导物
Small_Molecule_Drug.description: 小分子抑制剂、激动剂、变构调节剂或前体化合物
Small_Molecule_Drug.en_description: Synthetic small-molecule inhibitors, agonists, allosteric modulators, or prodrugs.

Biologics_ADC.label: 生物制品 / 单抗 / ADC
Biologics_ADC.description: 治疗性单抗、抗体偶联药物(ADC)、重组细胞因子或融合蛋白
Biologics_ADC.en_description: Therapeutic monoclonal antibodies, antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), or recombinant proteins.

PROTAC_Degrader.label: 靶向蛋白降解剂 / PROTAC
PROTAC_Degrader.description: 蛋白降解靶向嵌合体(PROTAC)、分子胶或靶向自噬降解嵌合体
PROTAC_Degrader.en_description: Proteolysis-targeting chimeras (PROTACs), molecular glues, or targeted degraders.

Disease_Indication.label: 临床适应症 / 疾病模型
Disease_Indication.description: 肿瘤适应症、神经退行性疾病、代谢病或动物造模表型
Disease_Indication.en_description: Oncological indications, neurodegenerative diseases, metabolic syndromes, or animal models.

Biomarker_Resistant_Mutation.label: 疗效标志物 / 耐药突变
Biomarker_Resistant_Mutation.description: 预后/伴随诊断标志物、靶向药获得性耐药突变位点
Biomarker_Resistant_Mutation.en_description: Prognostic/companion biomarkers or acquired drug-resistance mutation sites.

Uncertain.label: 无法判断 / 未定
Uncertain.description: 文献证据不足或上下文含糊、无法明确归类的药理实体
Uncertain.en_description: Pharmacological entities with ambiguous context or unverified classification.

Target_Inhibition.label: 靶点抑制 / 拮抗
Target_Inhibition.en_description: Functional antagonism or competitive/allosteric inhibition of target activity.

Target_Activation.label: 靶点激活 / 激动
Target_Activation.en_description: Agonistic stimulation or pharmacological activation of target receptor/enzyme.

Targeted_Degradation.label: 诱导靶点降解
Targeted_Degradation.en_description: Chimeric or glue-mediated induction of target ubiquitination and degradation.

Competitive_Binding.label: 竞争性结合 / 变构调节
Competitive_Binding.en_description: Direct competitive receptor/ligand occupancy or allosteric pocket binding.

Therapeutic_Efficacy.label: 抗病疗效 / 抑制肿瘤进展
Therapeutic_Efficacy.en_description: Demonstrated pharmacological efficacy, tumor regression, or disease symptom alleviation.

Drug_Resistance_Induction.label: 诱导耐药 / 旁路激活
Drug_Resistance_Induction.en_description: Induction of secondary resistance mutations, bypass activation, or efflux upregulation.

Adverse_Toxicity.label: 不良反应 / 细胞毒性
Adverse_Toxicity.en_description: On-target or off-target adverse effects, organ toxicity, or pathological liabilities.

en_description: Taxonomy focused on drug molecules, druggable targets, mechanisms of action (MoA), and clinical disease indications.
